in_arabic.name: ممدود
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم ممدود يعني الممدود والمطول في مدحه وتمجيده
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم ممدود هو من الأسماء التي تعبر عن المدح والتمجيد، حيث يشتق من الفعل مدّ الذي يعني التمديد والإطالة في الشيء، وينسب إلى الله عز وجل الذي هو أمدح وأتم مجداً، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر الممدود في سياق المدح والثناء على الله تعالى

data.cultural_impact: The name Mamdud holds deep cultural significance in the Islamic world as it connotes the idea of bestowing honor and giving glory. It is a name that evokes a sense of dignity, respect, and nobility. The name Mamdud is often given to boys born into well-respected and prestigious families, as it represents the idea of carrying on a noble legacy and upholding a proud family heritage. In many Islamic cultures, the naming ceremony is an important social event, and the bestowal of such a name is a source of great pride for the family.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mamdud holds profound significance as it is a reminder that the source of all honor and glory comes from God. The name Mamdud serves as a reminder that it is through God's grace and mercy that we are given the ability to bestow honor upon others and to give glory to God. It is a name that encourages us to strive towards living a life of dignity, respect, and nobility, and to use our God-given abilities to bring honor and glory to God and to those around us. Ultimately, the name Mamdud serves as a daily reminder of the importance of being a conduit of God's love and blessings in the world.
